title: Commercial Brand Manager
description:
Commercial Brand Marketing Manager

Flexible Location (Hybrid Work)

Are you an experienced brand marketer with a passion for developing impactful campaigns and building strong brand presence? We're looking for a Brand Manager to join our marketing team and play a key role in shaping and delivering brand strategy across a portfolio of products and brands.

This is an exciting opportunity to lead high profile campaigns, manage key partnerships and suppliers, and influence brand performance across multiple marketing channels.

The Role

As Brand Manager, you'll support the Brand Marketing Lead in developing and delivering integrated brand campaigns that drive awareness, engagement and commercial growth. You'll oversee campaign execution from concept through to delivery, manage budgets and supplier relationships, and use performance insights to shape future marketing activity.

What You'll Be Doing
- Leading the development and delivery of multi channel brand campaigns
- Managing supplier, agency and ambassador relationships to maximise campaign performance
- Identifying new marketing opportunities and supporting brand growth initiatives
- Overseeing media planning and placement across advertising, sponsorship and events
- Managing campaign budgets and tracking performance against objectives
- Analysing campaign results and providing recommendations for future activity
- Leading annual reviews of marketing collateral and brand assets
- Working closely with internal stakeholders to ensure campaigns align with business objectives
- Supporting and attending events, sponsorship activations and promotional activities
- Managing customer communications in line with GDPR, FCA and regulatory requirements
- Line managing and developing junior marketing team members

Essential Skills & Experience
- Proven experience in a brand, campaign or marketing management role
- Strong campaign planning and project management skills
- Experience managing agencies, suppliers or commercial partnerships
- Ability to analyse campaign performance and interpret business data
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Strong commercial awareness and creative thinking
- High attention to detail and organisational skills
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

Desirable Skills & Experience
- Experience within financial services or a regulated industry
- Experience managing ambassador or sponsorship partnerships
- CIM qualification or equivalent marketing qualification
- Proven experience delivering brand and marketing campaigns within a commercial B2 B environment

title: Paid Media Manager - Performance Marketing
description:
READY TO MAKE PAID MEDIA A REAL COMMERCIAL GROWTH ENGINE?

We're working with a high-growth, commercially driven B2 B organisation looking for an exceptional Paid Media Manager to take ownership of its performance marketing activity.

This is far more than a campaign management role. You'll be responsible for driving high-quality leads, improving conversion and scaling acquisition, with a direct line between your work and wider commercial performance.

If you're passionate about paid media, love getting under the skin of performance data and want genuine ownership of strategy, testing and growth, this could be your next move.

THE ROLE

As Paid Media Manager, you'll take ownership of paid acquisition across key markets, developing and executing strategies designed to generate measurable commercial results.

You'll work closely with senior digital and commercial stakeholders, alongside wider specialists across SEO, CRM, UX and CRO, to create a fully integrated acquisition strategy.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
- Own and develop the paid media and lead generation strategy across key markets.
- Plan, build, manage and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, LinkedIn and programmatic display.
- Set, monitor and evaluate meaningful performance marketing KPIs.
- Use GA4 and offline business data to improve lead quality, conversion rates and overall campaign performance.
- Build structured testing and experimentation programmes, including A/B testing.
- Identify opportunities to scale campaigns while maintaining efficiency and commercial return.
- Produce regular performance reporting, forecasting and actionable insight for senior stakeholders.
- Collaborate with SEO, CRM, UX and CRO teams to improve the end-to-end acquisition journey.
- Work closely with senior digital and commercial leadership to deliver ambitious growth targets.
- Keep pace with platform developments, emerging opportunities and paid media best practice.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You'll ideally bring 4+ years' experience managing lead-generation paid media, preferably across substantial monthly budgets.

You'll combine commercial thinking, creativity and analytical rigour, with a genuine appetite for improving performance.

You'll have:
- Strong hands-on experience across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta and LinkedIn Ads.
- Experience with programmatic/display advertising.
- A proven track record in lead generation and performance marketing.
- Strong GA4 experience and the ability to connect digital activity with offline commercial data.
- Experience developing long-term account growth and testing strategies.
- A data-led approach to optimisation and decision-making.
- Confidence challenging assumptions and presenting recommendations to stakeholders.
- A test-and-learn mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

WHY THIS ROLE?

You'll be joining a successful and ambitious business at an exciting stage of growth, where performance marketing is a key commercial driver.

This is an opportunity to have real ownership, influence strategy and build on an already established paid media operation.

You won't simply be managing campaigns - you'll be helping shape how the business generates, converts and scales new opportunities.

If you're ready for a role where performance genuinely matters and your results have commercial impact, we want to hear from you.

Apply now for a confidential conversation.

INDMANS

The Portfolio Group are acting on behalf of our client in recruiting for this position.

title: Senior PR Executive
company: Michael Page Business Support - Agency - Permanent
description:
A Senior PR Executive role based in North Manchester, focused on managing public relations activities to enhance brand visibility and reputation. You'll work closely with the marketing team to create and deliver effective communication strategies that support business goals.

Client Details

An organisation in the marketing and agency sector, based in North Manchester .

Description
- Develop and execute PR campaigns to align with the company's marketing strategy.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with media outlets and journalists.
- Monitor and manage press coverage, ensuring accurate representation of the brand.
- Draft press releases, articles, and other communication materials.
- Coordinate events and media opportunities to promote the brand.
- Analyse PR campaign performance and prepare detailed reports.
- Handle crisis communication and provide timely responses to media enquiries.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging across all channels.

Profile

A successful Senior PR Executive should have:
- Strong experience in public relations or a related field.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Proven ability to manage media relationships effectively.
- Skills in creating and implementing PR strategies.
- Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
- Familiarity with monitoring tools and analytics to measure campaign success.

Job Offer
- Permanent role with a hybrid working arrangement.
- Competitive salary ranging from £32,500 to £35,000, dependent on the level of experience.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: SEO Manager
description:
SEO Manager Greater Manchester Hybrid (2 days in office) £35,000 - £40,000 DOE

A fast-growing performance marketing agency is looking for an experienced SEO Manager to join their Search Marketing team.

This is a hands-on role where you will take ownership of key client accounts and deliver SEO strategies that drive measurable improvements in organic visibility, traffic, and commercial performance.

You will work across a varied portfolio of clients ranging from local businesses through to national and international brands, delivering both technical and strategic SEO.

The Role

Reporting into the Head of SEO, you will:
- Lead SEO strategy and delivery across a portfolio of client accounts
- Conduct technical SEO audits and implement actionable recommendations
- Carry out keyword research, competitor analysis and gap analysis
- Identify growth opportunities and prioritise SEO initiatives
- Manage website migrations and technical SEO projects
- Monitor performance and deliver client-facing reporting and insights
- Work closely with PPC, Paid Social and wider digital teams
- Take ownership of client communication and performance outcomes
- Contribute to ongoing optimisation of SEO processes and delivery

About You
- 5+ years' experience in SEO
- Strong technical SEO background
- Experience working across both eCommerce and lead generation campaigns
- Confident conducting audits, migrations and technical implementation
- Strong analytical skills with a commercial mindset
- Experience using tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and similar platforms
- Strong client communication and stakeholder management skills
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment
- Able to prioritise work based on commercial impact
- Understanding of how SEO integrates with PPC, Paid Social and wider marketing channels

Nice to Have
- Agency experience
- International SEO experience
- Content strategy or SEO copywriting experience
- Experience supporting pitches or pre-sales activity
- Exposure to cross-sell or growth opportunities within accounts
- Public speaking or industry event experience

What's on Offer
- £35,000 - £40,000 salary DOE
- Hybrid working (2 days office-based)
- Flexible working hours
- 25+ days holiday + birthday off
- Wellbeing and support programme
- Strong training and development culture
- Clear progression opportunities
- Exposure to a wide variety of industries and clients

A strong opportunity for an SEO professional looking to take ownership of client performance and grow within a fast-moving, performance-led agency environment.

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.

title: Paid Media Manager - Demand/Analytics/B2B SaaS
description:
Paid Media Manager - Demand/Analytics/B2 B SaaS

My client is Manchester's biggest tech success story and is entering an exciting new phase of growth. As they continue to scale, they're looking for a talented Paid Media/Demand Generation Manager to join their growing marketing team and play a key role in driving customer acquisition, pipeline generation, and revenue growth. This role would suit an experienced performance marketer from a B2 B SaaS environment who thrives on using data to drive decision-making. You'll take ownership of substantial paid media budgets across key channels, whilst providing the insight and analysis needed to shape wider marketing and content strategies. Whilst hands-on experience across Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads is essential, the business is equally interested in someone who understands how to connect marketing activity to commercial outcomes. You'll be highly proficient with Google Analytics, using performance data to optimise campaigns, identify opportunities, and support strategic decision-making across the marketing function.

Key Responsibilities
- Own and optimise paid media campaigns across Google Ads and LinkedIn.
- Manage significant marketing budgets, ensuring strong ROI and efficient spend allocation.
- Use Google Analytics and other reporting tools to measure campaign performance and business impact.
- Deliver actionable insights that inform content strategy, lead generation initiatives, and wider marketing activity.
- Work closely with marketing stakeholders to improve conversion performance across the funnel.
- Monitor, analyse, and report on key campaign KPIs.
- Drive a culture of testing, optimisation, and continuous improvement.
- Support broader digital marketing initiatives, including SEO and organic growth strategies.

About You
- Proven experience in a Demand Generation Manager or similar performance marketing role.
- Essential experience working within a B2 B SaaS business.
- Strong hands-on experience managing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads campaigns.
- Advanced knowledge of Google Analytics and performance reporting.
- Experience managing sizeable marketing budgets.
- Strong commercial awareness with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
- Good understanding of SEO, with organic search experience viewed favourably.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment

Altech Group is operating as a recruitment agency in relation to this vacancy.
